generated_notes: dockerstage knowledge base, spec v2 section 7.1. CURATION CONVENTIONS: (1) Debian package names target BOOKWORM, the codename implied by python:3.11-slim and later (spec 9.1 forbids choosing a codename independently); names that differ on bullseye or trixie are called out in the entry's notes. (2) build_time_system_deps lists what a SOURCE build needs, including the compiler and python3-dev; -dev package names are stable across Debian releases. (3) runtime_system_deps lists shared libraries required on the TYPICAL install path - populated when the package is commonly source-built or the wheel is known not to vendor the library (lxml, opencv-python, psycopg2, mysqlclient, xgboost), and empty when wheels reliably vendor everything. Where a source build would need extra runtime libs that the wheel vendors, they are recorded in notes with the prefix 'source-build runtime:' rather than installed unconditionally, because installing them always would bloat every image for a path that is rarely taken. This is a known modelling limitation, not an oversight. (4) All wheel_typically_available values were curated fresh for this file, NOT inherited from spec v1 (whose lxml=false was wrong). They are not yet machine-verified against PyPI: run tools/verify_wheels.py. (5) verified_by_build is false everywhere until a section 10 build confirms the entry; run tools/verify_imports.py to check import_names in a container.
